scenarios.question: In cloud API index cloud sourcetype aws:cloudtrail, compare successful and unsuccessful results by eventName, calculate the unsuccessful percentage, and rank the highest.
scenarios.reference_spl: search (index="cloud" sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail") | eval operation=eventName | eval state=result | stats count as total_events count(eval(state="success")) as successful_events count(eval(state!="success")) as unsuccessful_events by operation | eval unsuccessful_pct=if(total_events=0,0,(unsuccessful_events/total_events)*100) | sort 0 -unsuccessful_pct | fields operation total_events successful_events unsuccessful_events unsuccessful_pct | head 20
